cards.d: The element for flowers joins with the long horizontal stroke beneath it to create the picture of a bowl of salad.
Once upon a time, the children were forced to eat their salad every day.
A long time ago, people of the world got confused because there were so many kinds of metal coins, today we only have the euro.
cards.e: 錯覺 착각 illusion, mistake; 錯誤 착오 mistake, error; 倒錯 도착 perversion, inversion

cards.d: Once upon a time, Chuck Norris borrowed something from me. Do you think I'm going to ask for it back? No way!
cards.e: 借名 차명 borrowed name; 借用 차용 borrowing, loan

cards.d: It's a pity that his state of mind isn't what it was once upon a time. Alzheimers can be very tragic.
cards.e: 惜別 석별 unwillingness to part, to leave

cards.d: 'Once upon a time...' - Oh hell, you're just too old for this. You close your fairy tale book and set it aside, pushing it away with your fingers.
cards.e: 措置 조치 measure, step, arrangement

cards.d: The taskmaster is dissatisfied with the meal she's served, and scatters the salad and meat across the floor for the servants to clean up.
cards.e: 散策 산책 walk, stroll; 散步 산보 walk, stroll

cards.d: The two tens joined at the bottom by a short line is actually the old character for twenty.
The primitive for caverns differs from that for cave by the presence of the twenty, suggesting a maze of underground caves.
Commoners have to huddle in caverns around a campfire, while higher class people get heating and central air conditioning in a hotel.
cards.e: 庶民 서민 commoner, common people

cards.d: The commoners are revolting! We must intercept them on the road before they reach the castle!
cards.e: 遮斷 차단 interception, isolation; 遮日 차일 sunshade, tent

cards.d: If you want to take a seat in the caverns, they're often pretty damp - best to lay down a towel first before getting a wet ass.
cards.e: 座席 좌석 seat; 缺席 결석 absence, nonattendance

cards.d: The cave is twenty degrees cooler than the outdoors. Twenty male crotches experience shrinkage.
cards.e: 速度 속도 speed; 程度 정도 degree, extent; 態度 태도 attitude, bearing

cards.d: This particular form of transit is a ferry (one of the actual meanings of this character). Naturally it can only cross the water if it's not frozen, so the temperature must be above 0 degrees.
cards.e: 不渡 부도 bankruptcy, dishonor (bill); 讓渡 양도 transfer, cession

cards.d: The three needles stacked up give us a haystack (in which it may be harder to find the hay than the needles).
cards.e: 花卉 화훼 flowers and plants; 花𠦄 화훼 flowering plant

cards.d: Hustle and bustle = a big St. Bernard dog frisking about in a haystack, knocking it down and spreading the hay about, after the field hands just stacked it up.
cards.e: 自由奔放 자유분방 free-spirited; 奔走하다 분주하다 busy; 狂奔하다 광분하다 rush about, run madly about

cards.d: History of Pompei: An unexpect eruption and from the mouths of the volcano come lava that threatens the farmers collecting haystacks in the fields and the fisherman catching shells on the coast.
cards.e: 噴水 분수 fountain, jet of water

cards.d: After the eruption all is a tomb. The soil has covered the remains of the farmers gathering haystacks and of the fisherman collecting shells.
cards.e: 古墳 고분 ancient tomb; 墳墓 분묘 tomb, grave

cards.d: Someone's wild state of mind became aroused and indignant upon finding out that the money he'd hidden under the haystack is gone.
cards.e: 憤怒 분노 anger, rage, fury; 憤하다 분다 vexatious, vexing

cards.d: The two human legs added to the haystack (with the horizontal stroke to keep the two parts distinct from one another and avoid an ugly tangle) give us a straw man.
Ah, there's no better way to bake a pizza than an oven fueled by a burning strawman. And if you listen carefully, there are stifled strawman screams coming from the kitchen.
cards.e: 燒酒 소주 soju; 燃燒 연소 burning, combustion

cards.d: The first person to see the sun at daybreak is of course the straw man who stands outside all day.
cards.e: 通曉 통효 conversance, mastery

cards.d: 三 broken in half by a walking stick plunged through the middle.
cards.e: 半指/斑指 반지 ring; 半島 반도 peninsula

cards.d: The person who is your consort is most commonly 'your other half'.
cards.e: 同伴 동반 accompaniment; 伴侶 반려 companion, associate, comrade, mate

cards.d: A paddy ridge divides the rice field in halves.
cards.e: 湖畔 호반 shores of a lake, lakeside;

cards.d: King solomon was famous for his judgement. Two mothers who came before him to resolve a quarrel about which was the true mother of a baby. when Solomon suggests dividing the living child in two halves with a saber, the true mother is revealed to him because she is willing to give up her child to the lying woman rather than have the child killed.
cards.e: 批判 비판 criticism; 判斷 판단 judgement, decision, discretion; 裁判 재판 justice, trial, hearing

cards.d: This character simply splits the vertical stroke of a half in half once again, to get a quarter. In so doing, it spreads the split stroke out to form a sort of enclosure under which its main relative primitive will be placed. It can be used either in its substantive or verbal meaning.
及 fist* His fist is a quarter the size of his open hand.
cards.e: 跆拳道 태권도 taekwondo

cards.d: Entering the movie, the dude asks for your ticket, so he can tear it in half. He looks at you funny when you hand him a ticket already torn in half. He quietly tears the stub into quarters after you show him your dagger with a smile.
cards.e: 入場券 입장권 admission ticket; 旅券 여권 passport

cards.d: How to make snake maki: Take a snake. Roll it up in rice and nori (seaweed paper) like a scroll. Cut into quarters and serve on a wooden geta with ginger and wasabi.
cards.e: 卷 권 volume (unit)

cards.d: The entire sphere of human knowledge used to be pent into the library of Alexandria on scrolls. (oops, but then it all burned).
cards.e: 首都圈 수도권 the national capital/metropolitan area

cards.d: On the moon it only takes a quarter of your power to accomplish the same victory (because of the low gravity).
cards.e: 決勝 결승 final (match); 勝利 승리 victory

cards.d: The wisteria is a type of hanging vine covered with flowers. By the light of the quarter moon, the flowers look like clusters of rice grains.
cards.e: 葛藤 갈등 conflict

cards.d: Sending a facsimile to the moon can be problematic only a quarter of the words actually get there.
cards.e: 謄本 등본 a copy, a transcript, a duplicate

cards.d: A one-sided romance - he proposes and she says no. In the end what remains are just fragments of the heart.
cards.e: 破片 파편 fragment, chip, splinter; 片紙/便紙 편지 letter

cards.d: Printing block has a one-sided anti-image of what's being printed.
cards.e: 出版 출판 publication, publishing

cards.d: Of all the kanji, this is the only one 之orro can write.
cards.e: 隔世之感 격세지감 feeling of a different age; 感之德之 감지덕지 very thankfully, with deep gratitude

cards.d: Just one drop (of alcohol) and he starts walking in zig-zags – no wonder Zorro's living in destitution.
cards.e: 缺乏 결핍 deficiency; 窮乏 궁핍 destitution, want, distress, poverty

cards.d: Zorro, with a flower between his teeth for the ladies, defends his turf against evildoers. 'This is my turf! And this...is for the lady.'
cards.e: 靈芝 영지 a bracket fungus of the genus Fomes

cards.d: One below zero is a negative number.
cards.e: 不安 불안 anxiety; 不可 불가 wrong, unfairness, impropriety

cards.d: Negative mouths negate everything.
cards.e: 否定 부정 denial, negation; 安否 안부 safety, how a person is

cards.d: The maple tree is very negative about it, but the farmer still collects cupfuls of maple syrup from it.
cards.e: 乾杯 건배 toast
